canvas.note: Production sprite canvas. Player feet sit on ground_anchor_row; player centred on center_x. Same as approved east sets.

ball.note: Authoritative ball is composited SEPARATELY at gameplay-projected position; NEVER paint it into the sprite. East contact projects to (99,111) r5. Per-direction contact overlays are in 03_contact_overlays.

facing_read.note: The idle/locomotion rotation sprites are AUTHORITATIVE for facing if wording differs.

status.west: MIRROR of east (existing behavior, reference only)

INSIDE_R.identity: physical RIGHT foot strikes with the INSIDE (medial) surface; foreshortened medial boot facet; do NOT read as laces. Curve/target physics frozen.

LACES_R.identity: physical RIGHT foot, LOCKED ankle, instep/LACES through the ball. Not inside, not outside.

POWER_R.identity: hip -> knee lead -> shin through ball -> locked, MODERATELY PLANTAR-FLEXED boot -> MID-LACES contact; support foot grounded/braced; torso committed; arms counterbalance; NO jump-kick, NO toe-up, NO dangling ankle.

OUTSIDE_R.identity: physical RIGHT foot presents the OUTSIDE (lateral) striking surface (trivela). Not inside, not laces.

CHIP_R.identity: physical RIGHT foot, LIFTING/UNDER-BALL contact (toe/instep slides under the ball); short/checked follow-through. Not a flat laces drive.

anatomy_rule: Physical RIGHT leg is ALWAYS the kicker; physical LEFT leg is ALWAYS the support. This never changes with screen-left/right. Determine kicking leg from ANATOMY, never from screen position.
